title: Typing indicator
summary: Shows above the composer who in the chat is typing now, and tells the others when this account types.

typingNames.description: People typing now, without this account, in the order the SDK gives. Empty hides the line.

sharesTyping.description: The privacy setting for online and typing (bipe_privacy_presence). When off, the app neither sends nor shows typing.

draftChanged.effect: chat-timeline editDraft also sends typing on when the draft is not blank, at most once every 4 seconds, and typing off when the draft becomes blank, is sent, or the chat closes. Does nothing when sharesTyping is off.

notes: One name: bipe_app_typing_one. Two: bipe_app_typing_two. Three or more: bipe_app_typing_many with the first name.
In a DM the line shows the other person's name, like a group with one other member.
The setting is the presence toggle of ADR 0050: it controls online presence and typing only, never read receipts. Its screen is the privacy settings spec.
The line has a calm animation of three dots before the text. Screen readers announce the text once when it appears, not on every change.
